newsitem.title: USA: Hanwa ordered to suspend business -report.
newsitem.headline: Hanwa ordered to suspend business -report.

text.p: The Japanese Ministry of Finance is expected on Friday to order Wakayama-based Hanwa Bank Ltd to suspend all its business except for deposit withdrawals, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported in its Thursday edition.
The leading Japanese financial daily said that the ministry has determined that Hanwa, which mostly operates in the western region of Japan around Osaka, could no longer operate as a going concern.
The move follows a ministry investigation this fall over bad loans among Japanese banks, the Nikkei said.
After the investigation, the ministry determined that the bank will not be able to meet its requirements regarding its outstanding bad loans, the paper reported.
The beleagured bank was scheduled to report its earnings on Friday, it said.
